title: UI needs for Link in the web app (for the web session): control, session status, tempo, waiting, lost
description:
## Intent
Tell the web session what the UI needs for Link. This task describes needs, not visuals; the web/docs session designs and builds it (AGENTS.md: `web/src/ui/*` and `web/src/style.css` belong to it).

## Needs
- A Link on/off control, offered only when `custom.apricity.link` is present (local mode through `apricity serve --link`).
- Session status from `player.transport`: peers, session tempo, playing / waiting for the session to start / stopped, and "Link lost, retrying".
- When linked, the score's tempo is shown as "the score says 100" next to the session tempo, and editing `tempo` shows that it is not used while linked.
- Pressing play while the session is stopped (sharing start/stop) shows that it is waiting, not broken.
- Keyboard and screen reader: the control and the state changes are announced (relates apricitus-7edd75).
- The Docs tab already shows `docs/`; nothing extra.

## Verify
The web session confirms in a comment that each need is covered, with the files they touched; `npm --prefix web run build`.

Commit: by the web session, `feat(<this task id>)`.
